diagnosis: Glioblastoma arising in the setting of constitutional mismatch repair deficiency syndrome (CMMRD)
legend: Glioblastomas arising in this setting often demonstrate severe nuclear pleomorphism with bizarre and multinucleated giant cells.

diagnosis: Representative imaging of replication repair–deficient glioblastomas
legend: T1-weighted postcontrast MRI of a patient with constitutional mismatch repair deficiency syndrome with a homozygous MSH2 pathogenic germline variant. Note two synchronous tumours (arrows). Both tumours had secondary somatic mutations and ultrahypermutation, one involving POLE and one involving POLD1.

diagnosis: Representative imaging of replication repair–deficient glioblastomas
legend: A FLAIR sequence of a patient with Lynch syndrome and MLH1 heterozygous pathogenic germline variant. This gliomatosis-like pattern is typical for somatic mutation in IDH1 and hypermutation.

diagnosis: Glioblastoma arising in the setting of constitutional mismatch repair deficiency syndrome (CMMRD)
legend: This glioblastoma in the cerebral hemispheres of a child with CMMRD demonstrates a complete absence of PMS2 protein both in tumour cells and in normal cells, resulting from biallelic inactivation of the PMS2 mismatch repair gene in the germline of this patient.
